name: @factstack/registry
description: Site registry — the aggregator IR for FACTS discoverability. A pure `buildSiteRegistry()` that folds the MCP tool catalog, resource catalog, and route catalog from @factstack/spec into one `SiteRegistry` object. That IR feeds @factstack/site-kit's renderers (llms.txt, .well-known/mcp.json, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, …). Isomorphic, deterministic — `generatedAt` is passed in, never read from the clock.
